title: verification_record can stay pending forever for an idle initiating session: a status read that starts a new Engram child records no capabilities
outcome: A committed-input verification record is eventually delivered for an idle initiating session. Today, EngramHostAdapter::request (src/engram_host_adapter.rs ~2531, from w-decd61d62831) records nothing from a SessionBind/SessionStatus answer when no live child existed before the call (before=None): the first start, or after the 5-minute idle exit. The sender's per-run backoff can reach 5 minutes, equal to ENGRAM_CONTROL_IDLE_TIMEOUT, because it resets only on an ack or token change. Every later look then starts a fresh child whose answer is not recorded, so the record stays CapabilityUnsupported{NotRead} until other activity keeps the child alive, and acceptance refuses verification_record_not_acknowledged. Fix: when a status read starts a new child, re-read status once on that same child within the look; or keep the backoff cap below the idle timeout; or reset the backoff when the pending reason changes. A test covers an idle-exit cycle. Provenance: w-decd delta review round 2, Low (Claude delegation 2d36d89c).
acceptance: verification_record can stay pending forever for an idle initiating session: a status read that starts a new Engram child records no capabilities is done
